scope.measured: All production files except source maps and the generated metrics file.
scope.sourceMaps: Excluded from all budgets and reported asset lists.
scope.generatedAssets: Included when shipped in dist, including service-worker and manifest files.
scope.thirdPartyChunks: Included; dependency provenance does not exempt a shipped chunk.
scope.compressedSizes: Reported as gzip bytes for review, but raw bytes are the budget metric.
scope.budgetLevel: Aggregate JavaScript and largest individual JavaScript asset. No per-entry budget.
